name: Billing
pass_mark: Realised tax / declared volume lies within 0.20 x the NPA range of groups 2-4 for that year. Below the range is a billing leak.

name: Volume split
pass_mark: Error within 1.5x on unseen regions at 16 km.

name: Sinking maps
pass_mark: Signals repeat across periods and tracks above a random null.

name: Arizona leads
pass_mark: New large buildings with a new registered well within 500 m in t to t+2 are at least 1.5x the built-matched null; one-sided permutation p < 0.05.

name: Semarang permits
pass_mark: Leads fall on permitted wells more often than random new buildings of the same size, p < 0.05.

name: Field hit rate
pass_mark: No pass mark; reported per lead class with a 90 % interval.

name: SPAM test
pass_mark: Delta below the 5th percentile of the shift null, and both placebos between the 5th and 95th percentiles.

name: Positive control in Arizona
pass_mark: The same test detects a known, metered pumping cut.
